question_stem: Polonium-193 ($^{193}_{84}\text{Po}$) is an unstable nuclide. A nucleus of polonium-193 decays to a nucleus of lead-189 ($^{189}_{82}\text{Pb}$) by emitting an alpha-particle.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.part_stem:
Radioactive decay is both random and spontaneous.

parts.part_stem:
Data for the binding energy per nucleon of the particles involved in the decay of a nucleus of polonium-193 are given in Table 9.1.

Table 9.1
particle | binding energy per nucleon / $\text{eV}$

parts.text: Determine the energy, in $\text{eV}$, released when a nucleus of polonium-193 decays into a nucleus of lead-189.
